integration: Keep the monorepo shell, design system, shared dialogs and real-brain example manifest.
Adapt PipelineExecutor to QsmPipelineController and the shared WorkerSession protocol.
Fetch model weights through the shared downloader with upstream hashes and a pinned Hugging Face revision.
Build both WASM bundles with the repository's pinned nightly toolchain and shared cross-origin isolation support.
Keep monorepo date-based release versions and deployment workflows.
Load Inter from css/inter.css, which pins the Google Fonts v20 files, not from the mutable fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet.

Keep Cite owned by the shared shell. Move new upstream citations from index.html#citationsModal into registry/app-information.yml and test/app-information.test.mjs; do not restore the local Cite button, modal or handlers. The sync refreshes upstream-citations.json from its target commit and contract tests require every recorded DOI in the registry.
Keep the phase filename separator character class without the redundant dot escape; this preserves upstream matching behavior under the monorepo correctness gate.

When the pinned qsmxt-engine or its transitive qsm-core changes, rerecord packages/qsmbly/validation/browser-reference.json from the canonical production app. Replay the exact exported command with unchanged inputs against a checksum-pinned published native release under the existing numerical tolerances before changing packages/qsmbly/qsmxt.json. Browser and native core revisions may differ only with recorded compatibility evidence; test/node.test.js ties the reference to the actual Cargo commits and measured native version. Read the command from #commandPreviewText after app.showCommandPreview().

Keep `@playwright/test` and `yaml` declared as exact devDependencies for the monorepo e2e suite; the dependency checker rejects tooling resolved through another workspace's or the root's node_modules.
Keep the monorepo idle status: #statusText starts as "Drag and drop files" (design system); the window-wide drop comes from the shared components.

Keep the canonical Neurodesk workspace and shared controls. The upstream next.html/Preact preview is not imported; run its engine oracle separately against the pinned source when validating scientific changes.

Load dicompare's embed, worker and schemas from https://webapps.neurodesk.org/dicompare/ (this repository's deployment of apps/dicompare/public), not dicompare.neurodesk.org, whose GitHub Pages site stopped serving in October 2026; the rewrite keeps upstream's URLs pointed there.

The run worker's describeFailure comes from js/worker/utils/EngineFailure.js, the part of upstream's ignored js/next/engine/engine-call.js it uses; the rewrite points upstream's import there. Port changes to describeFailure by hand.

rust-wasm/src/lib.rs apply_mask_section sets masking.recipe_chosen so a QSMART export keeps the browser's mask recipe (QSMxT 1f72772 swaps an unchosen general default for QSMART's BET). Upstream has no such line: by QSMxT 9994450, which upstream pins, "Never change one setting to suit a method" removed the field and the swap. When the pin moves past it, delete both recipe_chosen lines and the test's !recipe_chosen assertion; keep the test's command and round-trip assertions.

Preserve the build.sh DL-only wasm-opt -Oz post-pass and its required-tool check. Keep threads, bulk-memory, mutable-globals and SIMD enabled, and validate real DL inference before accepting optimizer changes. This monorepo adaptation keeps the delivered module under the unchanged 25 MiB host limit.

build.sh serves the DL module gzipped as wasm/qsm_wasm_dl_bg.wasm.gz.bin and js/modules/ModelWeights.js loadDlWasm inflates it (keeping a host-inflated body as is) before passing the bytes to the wasm-bindgen init; keep both, and the bench worker's matching load, so no served file nears the 25 MiB Cloudflare Workers limit.
